name: rt_sheet1_chimneys
subject: this is a sprite sheet for the level Rooftops. Each grey box becomes exactly one game sprite, painted to fill its box edge to edge (its outer edge on the box's edge, no part outside its box, nothing touching another box). The magenta background stays one flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere outside the boxes: no shadows, no ground, no glow and no outline on it. TOP ROW, left to right. (A) the big box, 104 x 96 game pixels: a wide chimney stack of the old town. A sandstone slab cap on top, 6 pixels tall, overhanging the body by 1 pixel each side; under it a stucco body in the hotel painting's grey-brown stucco, a lit band down its left edge, a shaded band down its right edge, a darker shadow band right under the slab, two or three short cracks and one small patch of bare red brick. It is a solid obstacle the dog stands on, so it has an unbroken 1 pixel dark outline all round. No pots on it. (B) the second box, 64 x 96: a chimney block of the same build (sandstone slab cap 6 pixels tall, stucco body, lit left, shaded right, shadow under the slab), with a soot-darkened band of 3 pixels under the slab; an obstacle with a 1 pixel dark outline; no pots on it. (C) the narrow box, 32 x 96: the tallest chimney of the old town, a slim stucco stack with a sandstone slab cap 5 pixels tall; an obstacle with a 1 pixel dark outline. (D) the tall box at the right, 72 x 120: a wooden rooftop water tank. An upright drum of vertical wooden staves bound with three iron hoops, standing on four short iron legs with a cross brace between them in the bottom 20 pixels; a flat wooden lid on top, flat enough for the dog to stand on; an obstacle with a 1 pixel dark outline. BOTTOM ROW, left to right. (E) the wide low box, 64 x 24: three clay chimney pots standing on a short brick footing, decoration that sits on top of chimney B. Upright terracotta pots with a rolled lip and a dark opening, evenly spaced; no outline, their edges a darker shade of their own clay. (F) the small tall box, 24 x 48: one tall clay chimney pot with a flat rim on top; an obstacle with a 1 pixel dark outline. (G) the thin box, 40 x 10: a gull's nest, a shallow bowl of twigs and straw; decoration, no outline. (H) the little box, 20 x 30: a small plain chimney for the back row of roofs, slab cap and stucco body, lighter and less contrasted than A, B and C, no outline. (I) the box beside it, 22 x 40: a small back-row chimney with two clay pots on its slab, the same lighter back-row colours, no outline. The black dog stays exactly as it is: it only shows the size of one game pixel
extra: Image 2 is the approved painting of the hotel roof in this level: its stucco chimneys, sandstone slabs and clay pots are the exact look, colours, outlines and pixel size to follow. VIEW: a strict flat front elevation, like an architect's front drawing. The viewer looks straight at the front face of every object: no top surfaces, no side faces, no 3/4 view, no perspective, no vanishing points, no tilted or converging lines. Every horizontal edge exactly horizontal and every vertical edge exactly vertical. Round things (the pots, the tank) show as flat-fronted upright shapes whose roundness is only flat shade bands. Depth only by flat shade bands: a lit left edge, a shaded right edge, a darker band under every overhang. Light from the upper left. PIXEL GRID: Image 1 is a 320 x 240 game frame shown at 4x. The result is reduced back to 320 x 240 and every box is cut out by its rectangle, so draw exactly on Image 1's pixel grid: every pixel square, the size of the dog's pixels, aligned to the same grid; one flat colour per pixel; no anti-aliasing, no in-between edge colours, no dithering, no texture noise, no lone specks; straight lines stay exactly straight; nothing smudged or painterly. COLOURS, 3 to 4 shades per material, the darkest a neutral dark: stucco #C19674 #8D6D5A #624742 #4F4039; sandstone #CCAE8B #A28B75 #7F685F #473B39; clay #DF7B4D #AB503A #78352D #46201B; brick #AB503A #78352D; wood #9A7251 #75523E #623E2C #432A27; iron #5C5A64 #3A3840; outline ink #2D2224. Same crispness and level of detail as Image 2. No text, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no logos. The light described above only shades the inside of each sprite: no sky, no clouds and no cast shadows are drawn; the magenta stays untouched.
